summary: Attempt 1 never landed (the provider refused it twice) but left working Core, App and unit-test code; I built it, kept it after review and finished the rest. The store now records one watermark, the first size check not applied, written once as the last store write in Scanner.Run.Finish. ScanStore.SizeCheckPending, Unfinished and AtLeast derive from it, and a final snapshot flag StoppedInSizeChecks picks a third arm of MainWindow.ListHeader. Added this attempt: the 5M budget test, window case L-004 and the L-001 literal, plant rows S87 and P37, the design record, and a neutral EntryRules.ChecksOwnSize (the design's ScanStore.ChecksOwnSize broke an existing fitness rule). The full suite is 1096 of 1096 with no existing test edited, the rules harness is 169 of 169, and WindowMutants -Mutant All passed all 12. The published exe on C:\Windows\System32 shows the new header after a Stop in sizing.

obligations.how: UnfinishedTests.StopsInTheListingMarkWhatAPendingCheckCouldChange: a Stop after every AfterFolder (the last included), at the first six guarded calls (calls 1-2 leave an empty store, 4 empty stores seen), sampled calls before and during, every call of the 600-file folder that spans several listing buffers, and Cancel at ten entries of a commit. Each Stop's store is compared entry by entry with a flags-and-Parent oracle and with two scans that ran to the end; StoppedInSizeChecks is asserted false.

UnfinishedTests.StopsInTheSizeChecksMarkWhatAPendingCheckCouldChange, part (i), workers 1 and 4, ProbeBatch 8: Cancel from the ProbeRule seam on the scan thread while it builds the batch. prober.Calls == ordinal and Landing.Ordinal == ordinal are asserted, so the batch that comes back Cancelled provably started no probe; 15 stop points, floor Queued >= 10 counts landings, not triggers.

Same Theory, part (ii): Cancel inside a probe call before the real probe and after it returned, 14 call numbers each, workers 1 and 4; asserts the batch's first entry is the cutoff, a probe was made in that batch, and the cutoff is a whole number of batches.

Theory part (iii) and NothingChangesOnceTheScanHasReturned: every probe worker blocked on a gate with ProbeAbandonAfter 200 ms, Scan returns in under 5 s, the cutoff is the stuck batch's first entry, and the full store dump at the return equals the dump after the workers were released and left.

StopTree holds grow groups A, C, E, G (4 KiB listed, 1 MiB true) with the later name in an ancestor folder, beside it, in a later sibling branch and deep in a chain; Check requires the first name's folder and every ancestor Unfinished whenever its check is pending, in both Facts, and the charged name equals the reference's.

Shrink groups B, D, F (1 MiB listed, 4 KiB true, truncated through the later name): the teeth floor ShrinkAboveWhileAtLeastHolds >= 1 requires a Stop whose RolledSize is above the reference while AtLeast is not (162 in the listing Fact, 48 per size-check row); AtLeast <= reference is asserted for every unfinished folder.

Check compares every non-Unfinished folder's rolled and at-least figures with the reference by path, and floors LaterNameFolderFinalFirstPending (105 / 289 stops-folders) and CorrectedFirstFolderFinal (220) are asserted.

The Probe wrapper returns error 5 for pf1\x.bin and pf2\y.bin (ProbeFailed); the Fact floors RefusedCheckFolderFinal >= 1 (50), so a refused check counts as checked and its folder reads final; the reference scans assert r.ProbeFailures == 2.

TheReadAnswersAsAParentWalkOnEveryScannerShapedStore: 140 random scanner-order stores plus three with a 70,000-child block that straddles a page, with CloudOnly, repeated-ID, no-ID, link, empty and unlisted-last-subfolder shapes, watermarks 0, Count, random points and block edges, every Unfinished, SizeCheckPending and AtLeast against a brute-force Parent walk; empty store and EndSizeChecks(-1 / Count+1 / 0) bounds.

'Stop has taken effect' is Scanner.Scan returning. NothingChangesOnceTheScanHasReturned dumps the stuck-worker store at the return and after release (0 differences) and, per review m5, replaces the vacuous 200 ms listing row with an assertion that the folder committed after Cancel reads listed and its checked-kind files read pending (watermark 0); the listing Fact asserts the same at ten entries.

AScanThatRunsToTheEndMarksNothing: the sweep tree to the end, the SweepTree with five listed files deleted from an AfterFolder hook (VanishedBeforeProbe == 5), and a folders-only tree (Probes == 0, Completed): no SizeCheckPending or Unfinished anywhere, AtLeast == rolled, StoppedInSizeChecks false.

git diff --diff-filter=MD 4df2b1c -- tests/FsAnalyser.Core.Tests is empty (only two new test files); the counting-rule and last-access classes ran 161 of 161 green under TEMP=%LOCALAPPDATA%\Temp, and the whole suite 1096 of 1096 under the default engine TEMP, itself under %LOCALAPPDATA%\Temp.

Each case command was run once with its build: 5.6 to 13.1 s (Facts 0.7 to 2.6 s), recorded in the design doc; L-004 30 s, L-001 38 s with a publish.

Reworded to what is reached and floored on landings: the Cancel in part (i) comes from the ProbeRule seam on the scan thread, between one batch's apply and the next pass.Run, and every row asserts prober.Calls == ordinal (the cancelled batch started no probe) and Landing.Ordinal; the mid-batch rows assert a probe was made in that batch.

The vacuous 200 ms row after a listing Stop is dropped from NothingChangesOnceTheScanHasReturned; in its place the folder whose listing returned cleanly after Cancel is asserted listed with its checked-kind files SizeCheckPending (watermark 0). The stuck-workers rows stay.

MainWindow.ListHeader's listing-Stop arm says every row's size may be off, on disk especially; built with the later m1 disposition's wording ('leave out what the scan did not reach. No sizes have been checked yet, so any row's size may be off, on disk especially.'), which drops Q-283's 'are short' clause because run A and the at-least sweep measured stale-large rows above final. Pinned by $StoppedListHeader and L-001.

deviations: The 'sized from the file itself' predicate lives in a new neutral internal class EntryRules (Store/EntryRules.cs), not on ScanStore as designed. With SizeProbe.IsEligible calling ScanStore.ChecksOwnSize, the settled rule 'Core does not publish a live ScanStore before the scan ends' fired at SizeProbe.cs:28 and the rules harness's clean baseline was not clean. This is the neutral home the design listed as a taste choice; no fitness rule was widened.

The listing-Stop header is the m1 (later) wording, not Q-283's literal sentence: Q-283 keeps 'Rows marked ... are short', which survey run A and the at-least spike contradict (a stale-large first name makes a marked row high). Q-283's departure from Q-111 is kept; only the clause is dropped.

Tally.Bound is 15 s per Fact and is asserted at every Stop, not 60 s (design) or 25 s (finding M2) asserted once at the end: with 25 s the mklink-per-scan mutation still passed (24 s). The Facts take 0.7 to 2.6 s.
Attempt 1's stray UTF-8 BOM on Scanner.cs was removed so the diff is only the change.

Not read from the Q-160 assumption: Q-160 says Done rows' file sizes are complete and only on-disk is short; the measurements say Done rows can be above final in logical size too, so the header says 'may be off', not 'short'.
not_built: Review m2 (advance the watermark per applied batch rather than set it at the cancelled branch): waived, carried to SC-407.
Review m3 (EndSizeChecks seals the store against later writes): waived, carried to SC-408; the fitness rule fences the writer by file only.
Review m7 (a start-of-case sweep of orphaned L-004 roots): waived, carried to SC-409. L-004 does use a per-run GUID root under %LOCALAPPDATA%\Temp and [IO.Directory]::Delete.
Review m8 as a separate Core Fact: waived, carried to SC-410; Check and CompletedMarksNothing nonetheless assert StoppedInSizeChecks on every Stop and completed scan.

App wiring of Unfinished and AtLeast (a note on unfinished rows, the at-least figure, a Count 0 guard) and the stopped tree header for a Stop in the size checks: filed by the design for the SC-393 App slice; nothing in src outside the store calls the three reads yet, as with NotListedAtOrBelow.
The network pass (Cancel on a stalled share) was not run; it changes SMB mappings and is a person's run (lesson #136). No cancel-safety is claimed; the Stop path gains one O(1) write.
follow_ups: SC-393 lineage: show Unfinished / AtLeast in the App (guard Count 0 first, lesson #517) and give the stopped tree header words for a Stop in the size checks.

Any slice that applies size checks out of order, in parallel or partly (pause/resume, U-197) must replace the watermark with a per-entry or per-range structure and a 5M memory test; docs/design/SL-112-unfinished-at-stop.md names the obligation next to SL-111's.
Person-run network pass for Cancel on a stalled share (lesson #136), still unmeasured.
